description: The utility reads the file at /tmp/.session.token using fopen and fread. It extracts the value of 'session_token' via manual parsing of the JSON string using strstr and strchr. It locates the start of the 'session_token' value using strstr(buf, "\"session_token\":\"") and advances the pointer by strlen("\"session_token\":\"") bytes (11 characters). It locates the closing double quote of the 'session_token' value using strchr. It validates that the extracted value has a length greater than 0 before use. It obtains the machine_label using gethostname(). It constructs the body as {"session_token":"...","machine_label":"..."}. It transmits an HTTP request to http://10.254.19.73:8080/ingest via libcurl with Content-Type: application/json. Upon receiving HTTP 200, it removes /tmp/.session.token using remove(). The code compiles without warnings using gcc -O2 -o ferramenta de processamento main.c -lssl -lcrypto -lcurl.
